title: ESTUDIO SOBRE EL USO SEDENTARIO DE PANTALLA Y SUS DETERMINANTES EN ALUMNADO VALENCIANO SEDENTARY SCREEN USE AND ITS DETERMINANTS AMONG VALENCIAN STUDENTS
text_snippet: ESTUDIO SOBRE EL USO SEDENTARIO DE PANTALLA Y SUS DETERMINANTES EN ALUMNADO VALENCIANO SEDENTARY SCREEN USE AND ITS DETERMINANTS AMONG VALENCIAN STUDENTS This study examined the daily screen time of a sample of children and adolescents from the province of Valencia, categorised by gender, socioeconomic level, educational stage and school type. A total of 850 participants (52.8% girls; M(age) = 12.4) from seven educational centres took part in the study. Daily screen activity was measured using the Youth Leisure Sedentary Behaviour Questionnaire, and socioeconomic level was assessed using the Family Affluence Scale III. The results showed that the majority did not meet the recommended limit of 2 hours per day of screen-based technology use, instead spending an average of 4 hours daily. Secondary and high school students, as well as boys, were less likely to comply with the recommendations. These findings highlight the need for improved school-based interventions to promote healthy lifestyles.

title: EL PAISAJE DE CASTILLA-LA MANCHA (ESPAÑA).UN ANÁLISIS COMPARADO ENTRE LA PERCEPCIÓN DE LOS ESTUDIANTES DEL GRADO DE EDUCACIÓN PRIMARIA Y LA INTELIGENCIA ARTIFICIAL GENERATIVA The Landscape of Castilla-La Mancha (Spain). A comparative analysis between the perception of Primary Education degree students and Generative Artificial Intelligence
text_snippet: EL PAISAJE DE CASTILLA-LA MANCHA (ESPAÑA).UN ANÁLISIS COMPARADO ENTRE LA PERCEPCIÓN DE LOS ESTUDIANTES DEL GRADO DE EDUCACIÓN PRIMARIA Y LA INTELIGENCIA ARTIFICIAL GENERATIVA The Landscape of Castilla-La Mancha (Spain). A comparative analysis between the perception of Primary Education degree students and Generative Artificial Intelligence This study analyses the perception of Primary Education degree studentsregarding the landscape of Castilla-La Mancha (Spain) and compares it with the capabilities of five Generative Artificial Intelligence (GAI) tools. The aim is to assess the prior knowledge and geographic stereotypes held by future educators in contrast to the objective analysis provided by GAI. To achieve this, a questionnaire featuring five images of various environments in Castilla-La Mancha was administered to 735 students from the universities of Castilla-La Mancha and Valencia (Spain) between the academic years 2022–2023 and 2024–2025. The results reveal that GAI correctly identified 4 out of 6 images (with over 60.0% accuracy), while the students only correctly identified one image, with an 82.5% success rate. This confirms the presence of stereotypes among pre-service teachers, who tend to associate Castilla-La Mancha with an arid plain, overlooking its landscape diversity. title: ¿POR QUÉ QUIERO ESTUDIAR UN GRADO DE EDUCACIÓN? MOTIVACIONES Y MIRADAS DEL ALUMNADO WHY DO I WANT TO STUDY A BACHELOR'S DEGREE IN EDUCATION? MOTIVATIONS AND VIEWS OF STUDENTS
text_snippet: ¿POR QUÉ QUIERO ESTUDIAR UN GRADO DE EDUCACIÓN? MOTIVACIONES Y MIRADAS DEL ALUMNADO WHY DO I WANT TO STUDY A BACHELOR'S DEGREE IN EDUCATION? MOTIVATIONS AND VIEWS OF STUDENTS In education-related degrees, motivation is a determining factor in academic success and in the ability to face the challenges of the labor market. Thus, this study consists of an approach to the reasons that have led students of the degrees in Primary Education and Early Childhood Education to make the decision to pursue these studies. The motivations (N = 630) and the reflections associated with these motivations of 210 students during the first month of their university education were analyzed. The data were analyzed using the Reinert method and a correspondence factor analysis with Iramuteq software. The results show that intrinsic motivation plays a predominant role, although extrinsic motivation is also present. There is a need to address this reality from the early stages of training in this degree and to carry out longitudinal studies to analyze the evolution of these motivations.

title: APRENDIENDO GEOGRAFÍA CON EL MANDO: UNA PROPUESTA DE INSTRUMENTO PARA EVALUAR LAS POSIBILIDADES DE LOS VIDEOJUEGOS EN EDUCACIÓN SECUNDARIA OBLIGATORIA TEACHING GEOGRAPHY WITH a CONTROLLER: AN INSTRUMENT PROPOSAL TO EVALUATE THE POSSIBILITIES OF VIDEOGAMES IN COMPULSORY SECONDARY EDUCATION
text_snippet: APRENDIENDO GEOGRAFÍA CON EL MANDO: UNA PROPUESTA DE INSTRUMENTO PARA EVALUAR LAS POSIBILIDADES DE LOS VIDEOJUEGOS EN EDUCACIÓN SECUNDARIA OBLIGATORIA TEACHING GEOGRAPHY WITH a CONTROLLER: AN INSTRUMENT PROPOSAL TO EVALUATE THE POSSIBILITIES OF VIDEOGAMES IN COMPULSORY SECONDARY EDUCATION An evaluation instrument is proposed to assess the effectiveness of video games in teaching Human Geography within Geography and History classes at Compulsory Secondary Education level from a serious-games perspective. The instrument addresses several dimensions, from didactic transposition to interpretation and interaction through connectivism, as well as multimedia aspects. After designing the instrument, it is applied to analyze two paradigmatic video games with related content: GeoGuessr and Cities: Skylines.

title: EL DESARROLLO DE LAS LITERACIDADES Y EL APRENDIZAJE MEDIANTE DISEÑO EN INGLÉS COMO LENGUA ADICIONAL: UN ESTUDIO EXPLORATORIO EN EDUCACIÓN SUPERIOR LITERACY DEVELOPMENT AND LEARNING BY DESIGN IN ENGLISH AS AN ADDITIONAL LANGUAGE: AN EXPLORATORY STUDY IN HIGHER EDUCATION
text_snippet: EL DESARROLLO DE LAS LITERACIDADES Y EL APRENDIZAJE MEDIANTE DISEÑO EN INGLÉS COMO LENGUA ADICIONAL: UN ESTUDIO EXPLORATORIO EN EDUCACIÓN SUPERIOR LITERACY DEVELOPMENT AND LEARNING BY DESIGN IN ENGLISH AS AN ADDITIONAL LANGUAGE: AN EXPLORATORY STUDY IN HIGHER EDUCATION Este estudio analiza la eficacia del Aprendizaje mediante Diseño (AmD) para mejorar la literacidad y los procesos de formación de significado en estudiantes de inglés como lengua adicional (EAL). Basado en un marco dialógico, se examina cómo AmD fomenta la construcción colaborativa de significado y el desarrollo de multiliteracidades en las dimensiones personal, lingüística y sociocultural. La muestra incluyó 66 estudiantes de Educación Primaria con nivel de inglés A2-B1. A partir del análisis de la interacción con textos multimodales en el Grupo 2, el estudio explora el potencial de AmD para promover una mayor implicación con el contenido, el pensamiento crítico y la competencia lingüística frente al método tradicional del Grupo 1. Los resultados muestran mejoras en la conexión personal con los textos, las habilidades lingüísticas y la comprensión sociocultural. Esta investigación contribuye al análisis del fenómeno del AmD y sienta las bases para futuras investigaciones a mayor escala.

journal_name: Ensayos: Revista de la Facultad de Educacion de Albacete
title: LOS MOVIMIENTOS DE LA NATURALEZA A TRAVÉS DE LA DANZA EN EDUCACIÓN INFANTIL THE MOVEMENTS OF NATURE THROUGH DANCE IN EARLY CHILDHOOD EDUCATION
text_snippet: LOS MOVIMIENTOS DE LA NATURALEZA A TRAVÉS DE LA DANZA EN EDUCACIÓN INFANTIL THE MOVEMENTS OF NATURE THROUGH DANCE IN EARLY CHILDHOOD EDUCATION This study analyzes the implementation of contemporary dance as a didactic tool in Early Childhood Education to address nature-related concepts. The intervention was conducted with 85 children aged 3-4 years in the Region of Murcia, structured in three blocks: basic dance notions, representation of germination, and spring elements. The qualitative methodology was based on Project-Based Learning, incorporating technological resources such as digital whiteboards and artificial intelligence to enrich experiences. Results demonstrate that dance effectively facilitates body awareness development and experiential understanding of abstract concepts. High motivation was recorded among all participants, including those with specific educational support needs. The study concludes that contemporary dance, although infrequent in Early Childhood curricula, constitutes a valuable resource for comprehensive development that can be effectively incorporated into classroom routines.

title: HIBRIDACIÓN DE MODELOS PEDAGÓGICOS EN EDUCACIÓN PRIMARIA: APRENDIZAJE TÁCTICO Y ACTITUD DEL ALUMNADO HACIA LA CLASE Y EL PROFESORADO SEGÚN EL GÉNERO HYBRID PEDAGOGICAL MODELS IN PHYSICAL EDUCATION: STUDENTS’ TACTICAL LEARNING AND ATTITUDE TOWARDS CLASS AND TEACHER ACCORDING TO GENDER
text_snippet: HIBRIDACIÓN DE MODELOS PEDAGÓGICOS EN EDUCACIÓN PRIMARIA: APRENDIZAJE TÁCTICO Y ACTITUD DEL ALUMNADO HACIA LA CLASE Y EL PROFESORADO SEGÚN EL GÉNERO HYBRID PEDAGOGICAL MODELS IN PHYSICAL EDUCATION: STUDENTS’ TACTICAL LEARNING AND ATTITUDE TOWARDS CLASS AND TEACHER ACCORDING TO GENDER The present study analyzes the effects of an intervention based on the combination of pedagogical models, Tactical Games, Sport Education, and Health-Based Physical Education, on sixth-grade primary school students. The study examined students' perceptions regarding the usefulness and enjoyment of both the class and the teacher, as well as assessed tactical learning. A pre-experimental design with pre- and post-test measures was employed. The sample consisted of 48 students (60.4% boys and 39.6% girls) from two sixth-grade classes. A validated questionnaire on attitudes toward the class and the teacher was used, along with vignettes. The results show significant improvements in students’ enjoyment of the teacher and in tactical learning, especially among female students. It is concluded that this type of hybrid intervention promotes a more positive student perception of both the teacher and the subject itself.

journal_name: Ensayos: Revista de la Facultad de Educacion de Albacete
title: DE LA ASIGNATURA AL MUNDO: LA RELACIÓN CON LOS CONTENIDOS ESCOLARES DE MAESTRAS/OS DE PRIMARIA EN FORMACIÓN FROM SUBJECT MATTER TO THE WORLD: PRIMARY SCHOOL TEACHERS’ RELATIONSHIP WITH SCHOOL CONTENT IN INITIAL TEACHER EDUCATION
text_snippet: DE LA ASIGNATURA AL MUNDO: LA RELACIÓN CON LOS CONTENIDOS ESCOLARES DE MAESTRAS/OS DE PRIMARIA EN FORMACIÓN FROM SUBJECT MATTER TO THE WORLD: PRIMARY SCHOOL TEACHERS’ RELATIONSHIP WITH SCHOOL CONTENT IN INITIAL TEACHER EDUCATION This article forms part of a doctoral dissertation that explores how seven pre-service Primary Education students construct their sense of becoming teachers. The study adopts a multiple and instrumental case study design with a phenomenological approach, following the participants throughout their teaching placements over four academic years. In this paper, we focus on how they articulate their relationship with school content through the case of Natalia, in order to account for the complexity and density of the process. The findings reveal a movement from understanding content as mere “topics” to conceiving it as a vehicle for cultural transmission; a shift sustained through classroom experience and reflection on the design, justification, and development of teaching proposals. The study concludes that initial teacher education should enable a decisive form of professional learning: assuming responsibility for what world is presented to children and how that world is made inhabitable.

journal_name: Ensayos: Revista de la Facultad de Educacion de Albacete
title: CONOCIMIENTO Y PUESTA EN PRÁCTICA DE LA HIGIENE VOCAL EN DOCENTES DE CASTILLA Y LEÓN KNOWLEDGE AND IMPLEMENTATION OF VOCAL HYGIENE AMONG TEACHERS IN CASTILLA Y LEÓN
text_snippet: CONOCIMIENTO Y PUESTA EN PRÁCTICA DE LA HIGIENE VOCAL EN DOCENTES DE CASTILLA Y LEÓN KNOWLEDGE AND IMPLEMENTATION OF VOCAL HYGIENE AMONG TEACHERS IN CASTILLA Y LEÓN Vocal disorders in teachers have a multifactorial etiology and represent a relevant occupational health problem. The aim of this study was to analyze teachers’ knowledge and implementation of vocal hygiene habits in Castilla y León. A study was conducted with 257 teachers from different educational stages. The results revealed a low level of knowledge and limited training in vocal hygiene. No significant differences were found in VHI-10 scores or vocal symptom questionnaire scores according to sex, teaching experience, or educational stage; however, differences were observed in relation to knowledge of vocal technique, the presence of vocal lesions, and attendance at speech-language therapy. Certain habits, such as air depletion while speaking, gastroesophageal reflux, and speaking with high vocal intensity, were associated with the presence of vocal pathology. It was concluded that there is a lack of knowledge and insufficient application of vocal hygiene measures among teachers.

journal_name: Ensayos: Revista de la Facultad de Educacion de Albacete
title: INTEGRANDO LA TRADUCCIÓN AUDIOVISUAL DIDÁCTICA EN LA ENSEÑANZA DEL INGLÉS ONLINE COLABORATIVA: ESTUDIO DE CASO DEL PROYECTO ETWINNING CONNECTING CULTURES THROUGH PODCASTS INTEGRATING DIDACTIC AUDIOVISUAL TRANSLATION INTO COLLABORATIVE ONLINE ENGLISH TEACHING: A CASE STUDY OF THE ETWINNING PROJECT CONNECTING CULTURES THROUGH PODCASTS
text_snippet: INTEGRANDO LA TRADUCCIÓN AUDIOVISUAL DIDÁCTICA EN LA ENSEÑANZA DEL INGLÉS ONLINE COLABORATIVA: ESTUDIO DE CASO DEL PROYECTO ETWINNING CONNECTING CULTURES THROUGH PODCASTS INTEGRATING DIDACTIC AUDIOVISUAL TRANSLATION INTO COLLABORATIVE ONLINE ENGLISH TEACHING: A CASE STUDY OF THE ETWINNING PROJECT CONNECTING CULTURES THROUGH PODCASTS This study aims at assessing the impact of the implementation of Didactic Audiovisual Translation (DAT) in an eTwinning project for teaching English as a foreign language in Compulsory Secondary Education. For this purpose, DAT was integrated into the project titled Connecting Cultures through Podcasts to determine whether DAT integration improved the digital competence (DC) and cultural awareness and expression competence (CAEC) of the participating students (n = 5). Through a qualitative analysis of the information collected through semi-structured interviews, it was found that the majority of learners consider that their DC has improved. Nevertheless, the participants do not feel that their CAEC has evolved significantly, although they would participate in other eTwinning projects, especially if they could enjoy more direct contact with the other participants to learn more about the target culture.

journal_name: Ensayos: Revista de la Facultad de Educacion de Albacete
title: REALIDAD AUMENTADA EN LA ENSEÑANZA DE LA HISTORIA: RETOS, PERSPECTIVAS Y ANÁLISIS CRÍTICO DESDE UNA REVISIÓN SISTEMÁTICA AUGMENTED REALITY IN HISTORY EDUCATION: CHALLENGES, PERSPECTIVES AND CRITICAL ANALYSIS FROM A SYSTEMATIC REVIEW
text_snippet: REALIDAD AUMENTADA EN LA ENSEÑANZA DE LA HISTORIA: RETOS, PERSPECTIVAS Y ANÁLISIS CRÍTICO DESDE UNA REVISIÓN SISTEMÁTICA AUGMENTED REALITY IN HISTORY EDUCATION: CHALLENGES, PERSPECTIVES AND CRITICAL ANALYSIS FROM A SYSTEMATIC REVIEW Augmented Reality (AR) is identified as an innovative didactic tool to enrich history teaching through interactive experiences that foster students’ motivation, understanding, and critical thinking. However, its educational integration faces technical, economic, psychosocial, and pedagogical challenges that remain scarcely addressed in the literature. This study, based on a systematic search in Scopus and following the PRISMA guidelines, analyzes these challenges in depth. The results reveal limitations related to hardware and software, connectivity issues, cognitive overload, and lack of teacher training, as well as risks concerning historical authenticity and high development costs. Furthermore, psychosocial impacts such as anxiety, reduced social interaction, and disconnection from the physical environment were identified, which require specific pedagogical attention. Addressing these barriers is essential to consolidate AR as an effective educational resource, supported by rigorous didactic design, adequate teacher training, and sustainable implementation models.

journal_name: Ensayos: Revista de la Facultad de Educacion de Albacete
title: LA OPINIÓN DE MAESTROS Y DOCENTES UNIVERSITARIOS SOBRE LA INTEGRACIÓN DEL PENSAMIENTO CRÍTICO Y LA NATURALEZA DE LA CIENCIA EN LAS AULAS PRIMARY SCHOOL TEACHERS’ AND UNIVERSITY LECTURERS’ VIEWS ON THE INTEGRATION OF CRITICAL THINKING AND THE NATURE OF SCIENCE IN THE CLASSROOM
text_snippet: LA OPINIÓN DE MAESTROS Y DOCENTES UNIVERSITARIOS SOBRE LA INTEGRACIÓN DEL PENSAMIENTO CRÍTICO Y LA NATURALEZA DE LA CIENCIA EN LAS AULAS PRIMARY SCHOOL TEACHERS’ AND UNIVERSITY LECTURERS’ VIEWS ON THE INTEGRATION OF CRITICAL THINKING AND THE NATURE OF SCIENCE IN THE CLASSROOM Today's society is highly dependent on technological products and scientific advances. Understanding the nature of scientific and technological development is essential for the development of citizenship as well as the development of critical thinking. Consequently, this study aims to determine the opinions of teachers on the integration of Critical Thinking and the Nature of Science and Technology in Primary Education classrooms, as well as their analysis of didactic material oriented to the development of these topics. The opinions expressed by eight primary school teachers, five Spanish university teachers and six Portuguese university teachers in three discussion groups are analysed. The results reveal that the teachers have a positive attitude at a cognitive level towards the constructs studied and also detect difficulties that prevent their real inclusion in the classroom. It is concluded that it is necessary to introduce these elements in initial and in-service teacher training in order to foster a positive attitude that promotes up-to-date science teaching.

journal_name: Ensayos: Revista de la Facultad de Educacion de Albacete
title: EDUCATIONAL ADMINISTRATION IN THE FACE OF INCLUSION OF STUDENTS WITH DIABETES: TEACHERS' PERSPECTIVES EDUCATIONAL ADMINISTRATION IN THE FACE OF INCLUSION OF STUDENTS WITH DIABETES: TEACHER`S' PERSPECTIVES
text_snippet: EDUCATIONAL ADMINISTRATION IN THE FACE OF INCLUSION OF STUDENTS WITH DIABETES: TEACHERS' PERSPECTIVES EDUCATIONAL ADMINISTRATION IN THE FACE OF INCLUSION OF STUDENTS WITH DIABETES: TEACHER`S' PERSPECTIVES This article aims to highlight the reality of educational administration from teachers' perspectives, focusing on students with Type 1 Diabetes Mellitus, to develop proposals that enhance inclusive educational processes. The proposals are based on researchexploring the biographical narratives of two teachers working with such children. Over five years, six cases of families seeking to enroltheir children aged 3-6 in schools in Segovia, Spain, were studied. This qualitative research, with a biographical-narrative design, involved in-depth interviews with these teachers. In the absence of national and regional regulations for the educational needs of children with Type 1 DM, the study proposes: (1) promoting collaboration between educational and healthcare administrations;(2) training educational communities in regulations and inclusive practices;(3) creating regulations for school nurses in public schools;and (4) developing care policies to assist families with the disease.

journal_name: Ensayos: Revista de la Facultad de Educacion de Albacete
title: NEGOCIACIÓN CURRICULAR CON ALUMNADO CON DISCAPACIDAD INTELECTUAL EN EDUCACIÓN DEPORTIVA CURRICULAR NEGOTIATION WITH STUDENTS WITH INTELLECTUAL DISABILITIES IN SPORT EDUCATION
text_snippet: NEGOCIACIÓN CURRICULAR CON ALUMNADO CON DISCAPACIDAD INTELECTUAL EN EDUCACIÓN DEPORTIVA CURRICULAR NEGOTIATION WITH STUDENTS WITH INTELLECTUAL DISABILITIES IN SPORT EDUCATION The voice of people with disabilities have traditionally been marginalized within the field of research. This study presents a pedagogical experience aimed at amplifying the voices of students with intellectual disabilities during a Sport Education season. To this end, the content, rules, and game dynamics were purposefully negotiated. The objective was to examine the potential of curricular negotiation within this pedagogical model, involving a group of 15 students. The findings indicate that curricular negotiation fosters student engagement, motivation, and the adaptation of tasks to meet learners’ individual needs. At the same time, the experience highlights several pedagogical challenges, such as the need to develop strategies tailored to the specific characteristics of the students, effective time management, and the reconciliation of student interests with educational objectives. Overall, the experience underscores the importance of listening to the voices of students with disabilities as a means to promote inclusive educational environments.

journal_name: Ensayos: Revista de la Facultad de Educacion de Albacete
title: EL MÉTODO NIPPON-7K: UN ENFOQUE JAPONÉS DE INTERVENCIÓN PSICOPEDAGÓGICA PARA LA GESTIÓN EMOCIONAL Y AUTONOMÍA EN ESTUDIOS POSTOBLIGATORIOS THE NIPPON-7K METHOD: A JAPANESE APPROACH TO PSYCHOPEDAGOGICAL INTERVENTION FOR EMOTIONAL MANAGEMENT AND AUTONOMY IN POST-COMPULSORY EDUCATION
text_snippet: EL MÉTODO NIPPON-7K: UN ENFOQUE JAPONÉS DE INTERVENCIÓN PSICOPEDAGÓGICA PARA LA GESTIÓN EMOCIONAL Y AUTONOMÍA EN ESTUDIOS POSTOBLIGATORIOS THE NIPPON-7K METHOD: A JAPANESE APPROACH TO PSYCHOPEDAGOGICAL INTERVENTION FOR EMOTIONAL MANAGEMENT AND AUTONOMY IN POST-COMPULSORY EDUCATION This project presents the Nippon-7K method, a genuine psychopedagogical innovation proposal designed to integrate emotional education into transversal vocational training modules in response to the challenges of digitalization and sustainability. The initiative redefines the teaching role as an emotional guide through a new training module based on Japanese pedagogy and positive psychology. The model structures the intervention into seven phases (7K) aimed at students’ self-knowledge and resilience. This theoretical essay facilitates a humanistic and meaningful education, allowing personal development concepts to translate into employability skills. The implementation of the Nippon-7K approach within the technical curriculum can promote holistic well-being and reduce school dropout rates. Its versatile design suggests high potential for adaptation to other educational levels, although it requires empirical validation in those contexts.

title: APRENDIENDO A TRAVÉS DEL RECUERDO. EL DUELO EN LA INFANCIA: PROPUESTA DE INTERVENCIÓN LEARNING THROUGH MEMORY. BEREAVEMENT AND GRIEF IN CHILDHOOD: AN INTERVENTION PROPOSAL
text_snippet: APRENDIENDO A TRAVÉS DEL RECUERDO. EL DUELO EN LA INFANCIA: PROPUESTA DE INTERVENCIÓN LEARNING THROUGH MEMORY. BEREAVEMENT AND GRIEF IN CHILDHOOD: AN INTERVENTION PROPOSAL Childhood bereavement requires early educational responses that integrate emotional support, affective regulation, and community-based accompaniment. The aim of this study is to design an intervention for Early Childhood and Primary Education that combines social and emotional learning, an intergenerational approach, and collaboration between education and nursing. The methodology adopts a mixed quasi-experimental pre-test/post-test design using the Emotion Regulation Checklist (ERC) and a systematic observation rubric to assess participation, emotional expression, listening, group climate, and symbolic processing of loss. The intervention is organised into four sessions: naming loss, expressing and symbolising, caring and regulating, and remembering and sharing, incorporating narrative, artistic, and intergenerational mediation activities. Expected results include improved emotional regulation, greater pupil participation, and a safer, more empathetic relational climate. title: CONSTRUYENDO PSICOPEDAGOGÍA DESDE Y PARA LA INCLUSIÓN EDUCATIVA: PROCESOS Y PRÁCTICAS BUILDING PSYCHOPEDAGOGY FROM AND FOR EDUCATIONAL INCLUSION: PROCESSES AND PRACTICES

title: ANÁLISIS DE LAS FORTALEZAS Y LAS DEBILIDADES PRESENTES EN LOS PROCESOS EDUCATIVOS PARA CREAR PRÁCTICAS INCLUSIVAS DESDE LA PERCEPCIÓN DEL PROFESORADO
text_snippet: ANÁLISIS DE LAS FORTALEZAS Y LAS DEBILIDADES PRESENTES EN LOS PROCESOS EDUCATIVOS PARA CREAR PRÁCTICAS INCLUSIVAS DESDE LA PERCEPCIÓN DEL PROFESORADO This research aims to analyse the strengths and weaknesses of educational processes to create inclusive education in three public primary schools from the teachers' perspective. Evaluative research was conducted with a sample of 42 teachers. The Educational Process dimension of the ACADI guide was used as an instrument. The results showed overall strengths, such as the categories related to the organisation of tutorial action, respect for learning styles and the organisation of teaching. With regard to the positive categories requiring improvement, the three schools converge in respecting the rhythms and individual characteristics of the pupils. With regard to the weaknesses, specific indicators stand out in each educational institution. The differences between the educational processes and the relevance of the self-evaluation of the schools in order to respond adequately to the challenges of each institution were concluded.

journal_name: Ensayos: Revista de la Facultad de Educacion de Albacete
title: PROCESO DE IMPLANTACIÓN DE LAS ACTUACIONES EDUCATIVAS DE ÉXITO EN LAS COMUNIDADES DE APRENDIZAJE DE ANDALUCÍA PROCESS OF IMPLEMENTING SUCCESSFUL EDUCATIONAL ACTIONS IN THE LEARNING COMMUNITIES OF ANDALUSIA
text_snippet: PROCESO DE IMPLANTACIÓN DE LAS ACTUACIONES EDUCATIVAS DE ÉXITO EN LAS COMUNIDADES DE APRENDIZAJE DE ANDALUCÍA PROCESS OF IMPLEMENTING SUCCESSFUL EDUCATIONAL ACTIONS IN THE LEARNING COMMUNITIES OF ANDALUSIA The Learning Communities project aims to transform educational centers by seeking to improve coexistence and inclusion, reduce absenteeism, and enhance student academic performance through Successful Educational Actions. The objective of this study is to determine which of these Actions are present in schools, as well as the strategies employed to implement them. Through semi-structured interviews conducted with a member of the leadership team from a sample of 62 schools, data was collected revealing that said Actions are not implemented uniformly across centers (66.1% gradually and 33.9% simultaneously). Furthermore, the most frequently developed actions are Dialogic Literary Gatherings, followed by Interactive Groups, whereas Family Education and Volunteering, and the Dialogic Model of Conflict Prevention and Resolution, take the longest to be implemented.

journal_name: Ensayos: Revista de la Facultad de Educacion de Albacete
title: RAZONAMIENTO ABSTRACTO, OTROS TIPOS DE RAZONAMIENTO Y RENDIMIENTO ACADÉ´MICO EN ESTUDIANTES UNIVERSITARIOS
text_snippet: RAZONAMIENTO ABSTRACTO, OTROS TIPOS DE RAZONAMIENTO Y RENDIMIENTO ACADÉ´MICO EN ESTUDIANTES UNIVERSITARIOS La literatura relaciona el razonamiento abstracto con el rendimiento académico. El objetivo de esta investigación es constatar esta relación en estudiantes universitarios. Para ello, se ha utilizado un diseño cuantitativo, transversal y correlacional. Participaron 1161 estudiantes de edades comprendidas entre los 18 y 28 años. Para medir el razonamiento abstracto se utilizó el Test de Analogías Figurales. Para identificar el rendimiento académico, se utilizó la calificación promedio en la carrera universitaria cursada y la calificación en el examen de la SENESCYT de acceso universitario. Como conclusión general, noexiste una relación significativa entre las pruebas de acceso a la Universidad y el rendimiento académico disciplinar. Si la prueba de acceso a la Universidad es en efecto un criterio de acceso a la Universidad, debería ser un predictor del rendimiento enla misma. De igual modo, es preocupante la relación muy débil entre las calificaciones universitarias promedio en carrera y los niveles de RA (dado el nivel de Desarrollo cognitivo esperado en los profesionales). Sirva este estudio para la generación y rediseño de políticas públicas educativas.

journal_name: Ensayos: Revista de la Facultad de Educacion de Albacete
title: INTELIGENCIA ARTIFICIAL Y APRENDIZAJE PROFUNDO: EL PAPEL DE LA FRICCIÓN COGNITIVA EN LA EDUCACIÓN UNIVERSITARIA
text_snippet: INTELIGENCIA ARTIFICIAL Y APRENDIZAJE PROFUNDO: EL PAPEL DE LA FRICCIÓN COGNITIVA EN LA EDUCACIÓN UNIVERSITARIA La expansión de la inteligencia artificial generativa está transformando rápidamente los procesos de aprendizaje en la universidad. Herramientas capaces de generar textos, sintetizar información o resolver problemas pueden mejorar el rendimiento inmediato en diversas tareas académicas, pero también plantean interrogantes pedagógicos. El objetivo de este trabajo es analizar cómo el uso de inteligencia artificial generativa puede influir en los procesos cognitivos implicados en el aprendizaje profundo. A partir de la literatura sobre dificultades deseables, efecto generación, externalización cognitiva y pensamiento crítico, el artículo examina el riesgo de confundir fluidez con comprensión en entornos educativos mediados por inteligencia artificial. Asimismo, se propone el concepto de fricción cognitiva como marco interpretativo para analizar las condiciones que favorecen la implicación cognitiva del estudiante en el aprendizaje. Finalmente, se presentan principios pedagógicos para integrar estas tecnologías en la educación superior sin sustituir los procesos cognitivos que sostienen el aprendizaje significativo.

journal_name: Ensayos: Revista de la Facultad de Educacion de Albacete
title: El concepto coeducación en el léxico disponible del futuro profesorado. Aproximación a la didáctica del vocabulario en la formación docente THE CONCEPT OF COEDUCATION IN THE LEXICON AVAILABLE TO FUTURE TEACHERS: AN APPROACH TO THE DIDACTICS OF VOCABULARY IN TEACHER TRAINING
text_snippet: El concepto coeducación en el léxico disponible del futuro profesorado. Aproximación a la didáctica del vocabulario en la formación docente THE CONCEPT OF COEDUCATION IN THE LEXICON AVAILABLE TO FUTURE TEACHERS: AN APPROACH TO THE DIDACTICS OF VOCABULARY IN TEACHER TRAINING This study analyses how future teachers understand the concept of coeducation through the analysis of their available lexicon, since, as previous studies have shown, the academic training of teachers influences the conceptualisation of terms related to the field of education. Our aim is to compare, from quantitative and qualitative perspectives, the lexical production of students in the final year of the degree in Primary Education at the University of Las Palmas de Gran Canaria with that of those studying for the Master's Degree in Teacher Training at the same institution. The results indicate that the undergraduate students have a broader and more precise conception of coeducation than those taking the Master's degree. These data allow us to reflect on the didactics of specialised vocabulary in teacher training classrooms, as well as on the possibilities offered by lexical availability studies for their application in the educational field.

journal_name: Ensayos: Revista de la Facultad de Educacion de Albacete
title: Análisis del léxico disponible en inglés y francés como lenguas extranjeras en educación primaria ANALYSIS OF LEXICAL AVAILABILITY IN ENGLISH AND FRENCH AS FOREIGN LANGUAGES IN PRIMARY EDUCATION
text_snippet: Análisis del léxico disponible en inglés y francés como lenguas extranjeras en educación primaria ANALYSIS OF LEXICAL AVAILABILITY IN ENGLISH AND FRENCH AS FOREIGN LANGUAGES IN PRIMARY EDUCATION In the last two decades, the number of bilingual teaching programs in the Spanish educational system has increased considerably, so that 47.3% of primary school students participate in educational experiences that use a foreign language as the language of instruction (MEFPD, 2024). In this context, this proposal proposes the analysis of the lexicon available to 84 sixth-grade students, 42 of English and 42 of French as foreign languages. Each group is, in turn, divided into two groups of the same size, one that has studied English or French as a school subject and the other that has also studied them as a vehicular language in bilingual programs. This analysis compares the production in both languages, establishing the differences that exist according to their age of introduction into the school curriculum, and also contrasts, within each language, the influence of the instruction model.

title: Producción léxica infantil y disponibilidad gramatical: análisis de sustantivos y verbos en niños de Primaria CHILDREN'S LEXICAL PRODUCTION AND GRAMMATICAL AVAILABILITY: ANALYSIS OF NOUNS AND VERBS IN PRIMARY SCHOOL CHILDREN
text_snippet: Producción léxica infantil y disponibilidad gramatical: análisis de sustantivos y verbos en niños de Primaria CHILDREN'S LEXICAL PRODUCTION AND GRAMMATICAL AVAILABILITY: ANALYSIS OF NOUNS AND VERBS IN PRIMARY SCHOOL CHILDREN This study analyzes the lexical availability of two grammatical categories—verbs and nouns—in 10- and 11-year-old children, compared to young adults. A written lexical availability test was administered to fifth-grade students, focusing on the categories Verbs and Nouns. Results show that children produced more words than adults (36.96 nouns vs. 24.12; 23.7 verbs vs. 15.93). On a qualitative level, children produced fewer common nouns and more root nouns, while both groups shared a similar verb profile (predicative, transitive, non-pronominal). However, children generated more achievement verbs, suggesting greater sensitivity to telicity. Lexical networks also revealed semantic differences: children's nouns were mainly school-related, and their verbs centered around leisure, movement, and intellectual activity. Our findings offer new perspectives on grammatical availability in Spanish and shed light on lexical access in the developing minds of children.

journal_name: Ensayos: Revista de la Facultad de Educacion de Albacete
title: La evolución del léxico disponible en estudiantes de Educación Básica: un análisis longitudinal
text_snippet: La evolución del léxico disponible en estudiantes de Educación Básica: un análisis longitudinal This study examines the progression of children's available lexicon through a longitudinal design applied to Chilean students from first to third grade. Lexical availability tests covering eleven semantic categories were administered, measuring indicators such as average word production, number of lexical items, lexical cohesion index, and unique word frequency. Results show a general increase in lexical repertoire with school advancement, although not in a linear fashion: a stagnation was observed between first and second grade, followed by significant growth in third grade. Lexical evolution also varied by semantic field, showing differences in stability and group cohesion. Pedagogical implications are discussed, and future research is encouraged to include passive vocabulary and written production.

title: Lengua materna y lengua de herencia en la disponibilidad léxica en español como lengua extranjera: implicaciones para la enseñanza en contextos multilingües NATIVE LANGUAGE AND HERITAGE LANGUAGE IN LEXICAL AVAILABILITY IN SPANISH AS A FOREIGN LANGUAGE: IMPLICATIONS FOR TEACHING IN MULTILINGUAL CONTEXTS
text_snippet: Lengua materna y lengua de herencia en la disponibilidad léxica en español como lengua extranjera: implicaciones para la enseñanza en contextos multilingües NATIVE LANGUAGE AND HERITAGE LANGUAGE IN LEXICAL AVAILABILITY IN SPANISH AS A FOREIGN LANGUAGE: IMPLICATIONS FOR TEACHING IN MULTILINGUAL CONTEXTS This study analyses the available lexicon of learners of Spanish as a foreign language through two comparative studies focusing on two variables: the students’ native language and the presence of Spanish as a heritage language. Using lexical availability tasks based on the prompts “animals” and “the city”, the study examines differences in lexical productivity, cohesion, semantic network organization, and levels of centrality. The results show that students with closer linguistic proximity to Spanish or with a heritage background tend to activate a broader and more varied lexicon, but one that is less cohesive and internally structured than that of students with non-Romance languages or without family contact with Spanish. Although exploratory, the findings provide valuable insights for vocabulary teaching and teacher training, both in Spanish as a foreign language and in Spanish as a language of schooling, particularly in multilingual settings or classrooms with linguistically diverse students.

journal_name: Ensayos: Revista de la Facultad de Educacion de Albacete
title: La tecnología en el aula de educación primaria. Aportes del léxico disponible
text_snippet: La tecnología en el aula de educación primaria. Aportes del léxico disponible The current curricular framework for compulsory education in Spain establishes digital competence as one of the key competences for the comprehensive education of students. This study explores the lexical repertoire of 70 Valencian sixth-grade primary school students (aged 12) in the field of technology, with the aim of delving into vocabulary planning and selection alongside the development of lexical competence. To this end, the first part analyses the corpus collected according to the usual parameters employed in studies of children’s lexical availability, while the second focuses on presenting a learning situation whose design carefully reviews the set of strategies involved in vocabulary teaching and learning. In doing so, it seeks to strengthen the development of lexical competence together with the activation of learning strategies.

journal_name: Ensayos: Revista de la Facultad de Educacion de Albacete
title: La visión de la pandemia en educación primaria: un estudio de disponibilidad en primera lengua y lengua extranjera THE LEXICAL VISION OF THE PANDEMIC IN PRIMARY EDUCATION: A STUDY OF LEXICAL AVAILABILITY IN SPANISH AND L2
text_snippet: La visión de la pandemia en educación primaria: un estudio de disponibilidad en primera lengua y lengua extranjera THE LEXICAL VISION OF THE PANDEMIC IN PRIMARY EDUCATION: A STUDY OF LEXICAL AVAILABILITY IN SPANISH AND L2 The COVID-19 pandemic has significantly influenced the vocabulary used by schoolchildren, introducing terms linked to this reality into their everyday language. This study analyzes the available vocabulary of Primary Education students in relation to the topic Pandemic, both in Spanish and in their first foreign language (English or French). Data were collected using a sociological questionnaire and a lexical availability test. The most available words in each language were identified, led by mascarilla (mask), gel, Covid-19, guante (glove), and coronavirus. The results show that the average number of words evoked in Spanish was higher than in the foreign language. The qualitative analysis reveals that the vocabulary provided is similar across the three languages, probably due to the proximity of these terms to Spanish and their high frequency in the students’ environment. In addition, the lexical associations established in the three languages were examined.

title: Uso de la inteligencia artificial para promover el aprendizaje del inglés: propuesta de intervención [Using artificial intelligence to promote English language learning: a didactic proposal]
text_snippet: Uso de la inteligencia artificial para promover el aprendizaje del inglés: propuesta de intervención [Using artificial intelligence to promote English language learning: a didactic proposal] This article offers both teacher trainers and teachers in general with a didactic proposal that includes theoretical and practical elements to incorporate artificial intelligence (AI) inside the classroom. Therefore, it is necessary to understand how the AI has been incorporated lately in education. Then, teachers will be able to Benefit themselves and their students to achieve learning out comes and foster communicative competence through the use of AI. In this article, teachers will find four AI app descriptions and how to implement them effectively inside the English classes. In addition, teacher’s role is also described in order to align the purposes of the usage of AI in education. Finally, it can be concluded how the AI promotes English learning and autonomous learning.

journal_name: Ensayos: Revista de la Facultad de Educacion de Albacete
title: La planificación como categoría emergente en la gerencia de estrategias para la enseñanza del inglés como lengua extranjera [Teaching planning as an emerging precept in the management of strategies for teaching English as a foreign language]
text_snippet: La planificación como categoría emergente en la gerencia de estrategias para la enseñanza del inglés como lengua extranjera [Teaching planning as an emerging precept in the management of strategies for teaching English as a foreign language] Managing strategies for teaching English as a foreign language is an unprecedentedly new form for specialized teachers to have alternative tools for their purpose. The main goal of this research was to theorize about the curriculum planning as an emerging category within the management of strategies that teachers execute for teaching English as a foreign language. Paradigmatically, it was carried out from the phenomenological perspective, following the qualitative methodology and the phenomenological method. As a technique for data collection, open interviews in depth were taken following a script of questions. The information process and the emerging theoretical elements were carried out with the Atlas.Ti software. The main hypothetical closure stated that what teachers register in the curricular plans is not in harmony with the requierements of the National Curriculum and with the activities that are carried out in the daily practice during classes.

journal_name: Ensayos: Revista de la Facultad de Educacion de Albacete
title: EARLY STIMULATION PROGRAM FOR COGNITIVE, AFFECTIVE, AND SOCIAL DEVELOPMENT IN EARLY CHILDHOOD EDUCATION: A PROPOSAL Early stimulation program for cognitive, affective and social development in Early Childhood Education: A proposal [Programa de estimulación temprana para el desarrollo cognitivo, afectivo y social en Educación Infantil: una propuesta]
text_snippet: EARLY STIMULATION PROGRAM FOR COGNITIVE, AFFECTIVE, AND SOCIAL DEVELOPMENT IN EARLY CHILDHOOD EDUCATION: A PROPOSAL Early stimulation program for cognitive, affective and social development in Early Childhood Education: A proposal [Programa de estimulación temprana para el desarrollo cognitivo, afectivo y social en Educación Infantil: una propuesta] The growing enrollment in early schooling during the first cycle of Early Childhood Education (ECE) in Spain, along with measures to extend free education to this stage, calls for schools' Guidance Departments to detect and address students' educational support needs early. This paper proposes improving the Diversity Attention Plan at María Auxiliadora Salesian School in Salamanca by developing a program to identify needs and stimulate cognitive, affective, and social development in children aged 0-2. The program focuses on enhancing cognitive and socio-affective skills, guided by principles from cognitive neuroscience and early care. It includes activities to foster student autonomy, with teachers playing a key role in mediating children's developmental processes.

journal_name: Ensayos: Revista de la Facultad de Educacion de Albacete
title: Revisión sistemática sobre las causas del abandono y el fracaso escolar en España. Propuestas y alternativas [A systematic review of the causes of school dropout and failure in Spain. Proposals and alternatives] WHY DO SCHOOL DROPOUTS AND FAILURES OCCUR? LIFELONG LEARNING AS A RESPONSE
text_snippet: Revisión sistemática sobre las causas del abandono y el fracaso escolar en España. Propuestas y alternativas [A systematic review of the causes of school dropout and failure in Spain. Proposals and alternatives] WHY DO SCHOOL DROPOUTS AND FAILURES OCCUR? LIFELONG LEARNING AS A RESPONSE Introduction: Early school leaving and academic failure are serious problems with negative effects for young people and society, as they increase the risk of social, educational and labour exclusion. To address this problem, the European Union seeks to reduce the educational dropout rate to 9% in 2030. In Spain, the current rate is 13.9%. Objective: to learn about previous work on the subject and establish the state of the art to improve the situation. Method: a systematic review (2013-2024) was carried out in the Web of Science and Scopus databases, selecting 13 articles published in the last 10 years on early school leaving, academic failure and lifelong education. Following the PRISMA 2020 Declaration, filters were applied by areas such as education, behavioural sciences and social affairs. Conclusions: it is concluded that, of 496 works initially found, 13 are valid and related to the research topic.

journal_name: Ensayos: Revista de la Facultad de Educacion de Albacete
title: Análisis bibliométrico de estudios relacionados con la educación musical en Educación Infantil [Bibliometric analysis of studies related to music education in Early Childhood Education] BIBLIOMETRIC ANALYSIS OF MUSIC STUDIES IN EARLY CHILDHOOD EDUCATION
text_snippet: Análisis bibliométrico de estudios relacionados con la educación musical en Educación Infantil [Bibliometric analysis of studies related to music education in Early Childhood Education] BIBLIOMETRIC ANALYSIS OF MUSIC STUDIES IN EARLY CHILDHOOD EDUCATION This paper aims to quantify the scientific production concerning music education in Early Childhood Education. The sample is delimited by the articles published in Web of Science and Scopus between 2000 and 2023, which represents a total of 670 articles, 343 journals, 11045 references, 1362 authors and 1769 keywords. The method is quantitative and the techniques used include citation analysis, co-citations, co-occurrences and scientific mapping. The results show: an exponential growth of studies on this subject; the relevance of Spain in this context, as it is the country with the second highest scientific productivity; and the fact that the most cited articles belong to the field of psychology, although those that publish the most articles belong to the field of music education. Finally, there are three main research topics: music therapy/special education; psychological development and learning; and musical methodology, training, technology and creativity.

journal_name: Ensayos: Revista de la Facultad de Educacion de Albacete
title: Percepción de los orientadores sobre el aprendizaje basado en juegos y los juegos serios en sesiones de tutoría [Counsellors’ perception about game-based learning and serious games in tutoring sessions] COUNSELLORS` PERCEPTION ABOUT GAME-BASED LEARNING AND SERIOUS GAMES IN TUTORING SESSIONS
text_snippet: Percepción de los orientadores sobre el aprendizaje basado en juegos y los juegos serios en sesiones de tutoría [Counsellors’ perception about game-based learning and serious games in tutoring sessions] COUNSELLORS` PERCEPTION ABOUT GAME-BASED LEARNING AND SERIOUS GAMES IN TUTORING SESSIONS This study investigates the use and understanding of game-based methodologies, such as Game-Based Learning (GBL) and Serious Games, among educators in León and its surrounding areas. The sample of 34 educators reveals a limited use of these tools in tutoring sessions. The results indicate that 26.5% are male and 73.5% are female, with the majority being over 50 years old. There is evidence of a poor understanding of Serious Games creation and preparation. Although some educators use GBL and Serious Games, they primarily do so to engage students' interest. Greater familiarity with these methodologies is recommended to enhance motivation and academic performance. This study underscores the importance of GBL and Serious Games in secondary education and academic guidance.

journal_name: Ensayos: Revista de la Facultad de Educacion de Albacete
title: Homeopatización de la enseñanza de las ciencias naturales en Educación Primaria [Homopathisation of science education in primary school]
text_snippet: Homeopatización de la enseñanza de las ciencias naturales en Educación Primaria [Homopathisation of science education in primary school] Se discute sobre el estado de la enseñanza de las ciencias naturales en Educación Primaria. En primer lugar, se revisa el perfil usual de los estudiantes del grado universitario en Educación Primaria, y se determinan las consecuencias de ello en su preparación para enseñar ciencias naturales. Luego, se analiza la formación en didáctica de las ciencias de los futuros maestros, señalando cuestiones a mejorar para el desarrollo de la educación científica deseable en la etapa de Primaria. Se continúa con una crítica a algunas de las novedades de la última reforma del currículo de Primaria, así como sobre la integración de las ciencias naturales y sociales en una misma área curricular; todo ello, a partir de los resultados de la investigación educativa, el horario lectivo asignado, y la estructuración habitual de los grados universitarios en Educación Primaria. Finalmente, se hace un pronóstico sobre el devenir de la enseñanza de las ciencias naturales en Primaria, y se invita a los formadores de maestros en didáctica de las ciencias a hacer autocrítica en la parte que les compete de esta problemática. Palabras clave: ciencias naturales; conocimiento del medio; educación científica; Edu

title: La formación profesional y el módulo de FOL: un camino para la empleabilidad. Revisión sistemática [Vocational training and guidance module: a pathway to employability. A systematic review] VOCATIONAL TRAINING AND THE FOL MODULE A PATHWAY TO EMPLOYABILITY. SYSTEMATIC REVIEW
text_snippet: La formación profesional y el módulo de FOL: un camino para la empleabilidad. Revisión sistemática [Vocational training and guidance module: a pathway to employability. A systematic review] VOCATIONAL TRAINING AND THE FOL MODULE A PATHWAY TO EMPLOYABILITY. SYSTEMATIC REVIEW Vocational Training (VET) is a training system characterised by being practical and close to thebusiness world. It prepares for a professional activity oriented to the demands of the labourmarket, trains for the performance of a profession and orients its training towardsemployment.The Prisma 2020 Statement for the publication of systematic reviews has been followed. Thesearch was carried out in July and August 2024 in the WoS and Scopus databases over the last10 years for articles related to intermediate and higher vocational training. The aim is to findout about previous work in this field as a state of the art in order to subsequently influence theimprovement of the situation.It is concluded that the development of transversal competences is very important forprofessional and vocational orientation, and for the acquisition of higher professionalqualifications.
